chapter: Sing, Ho, For the Greatness of Fat!
act_title: Sing, Ho, For the Greatness of Fat!

quests.title: Sing, Ho, For the Greatness of Fat!

dialogue.t: Ah, valiant passerby, since you've come all the way to Teteocan, I take it you're someone seeking strength, aren't you?
Perhaps you've already seen some that the Collective of Plenty would call strong. Hah. Bunch of meatheads, they are, if you ask me.
But you? You're pretty lean — not yet one of those gym addicts obsessed with their daily lifts and bench-presses, I'm sure.
I'll tell you what, all of that is a scam. Don't be fooled.
Well, maybe things aren't as simple as that. But muscle worship and the claim that a warrior's strength flows from them? Absolute nonsense.
Know this! The heroes of old could never have had bodies that were nothing but skin, bones, and muscle.
They lived in far harsher conditions than we do today, where survival and defense were paramount. To endure real combat, they would've definitely maintained a healthy layer of fat for protection.
As such, their physique would've been more like mine.
Yes, this slightly chubby build I've got is what the heroes of old would've had — a body that balances impact and agility.
But sadly, the people of this tribe just can't see the truth. Ugh, idiots all.
You don't look entirely convinced... Hmm, how about this?
Try out the jar-smashing challenge I've constructed! I set this location up to train myself, but I wouldn't mind letting you have a go.
You'll see just how powerful a larger build can be in real combat once you've given this a shot!

dialogue.sit: Allow me to give it a try.
I'll need a moment to prepare.

dialogue.t: No problem, come back whenever you're prepared.

dialogue.t: No problem, come back whenever you're prepared.
Try out the jar-smashing challenge I've constructed! I set this location up to train myself, but I wouldn't mind letting you have a go.
You'll see just how powerful a larger build can be in real combat once you've given this a shot!
Hehe. Not bad, but you're still a bit behind me.
I've been rocking the slightly chubby look for a while now, but trust me, I've never skimped on my training. My agility and impact are way beyond those clueless gym junkies.
Forget chasing muscles — come join me in celebrating the greatness of fat!
Hey, valiant passerby over there — yes, you!
Sigh, you're so skinny... Have you been eating properly?

dialogue.sit: But... all the food got eaten by my guide, Paimon.
Huh? Are you offering to treat me to a meal?

dialogue.t: No matter what your reasons or struggles might be, the first rule is: you must eat well!
Since you've made it to Teteocan, you've probably already seen the warriors from Collective of Plenty, right?
Out of the goodness of my heart, let me give you a piece of advice: never trust those guys who are obsessed with preaching about muscles.
The fat that the Archon blessed us with is a precious gift. Giving up all the delicious food and losing your fat just to chase after some flashy muscles?
That's the dumbest thing ever. Even the forest boars would pity you.
And honestly, if we're talking about what looks good, this whole muscle-worship thing only became popular in the last few decades.
My grandpa told me that back in his day, people actually preferred a slightly fuller figure.
So, don't let anyone mislead you into going down the wrong path to lose weight!
But, if one day you end up like my relatives from Collective of Plenty and decide to lose weight in the name of strength...
Here's something else to remember: when it comes to agility, warriors with a slightly chubby build can also be as nimble as fish. But when it comes to strength, those skinny guys are no match for us.
If you need proof, just look at the jars on this training ground.
With my build, I can easily <color=#00E1FFFF>sprint through without breaking a single jar</color>. I bet even the skinny ones couldn't pull that off with this level of agility, don't you think?
Oh, I can see it — you're trying not to laugh, huh? Fine... I know you don't believe me.
Come on, give it a try! Run through this training ground as fast as you can, but be sure <color=#00E1FFFF>not to break any of the jars</color>!
Let's see how well you do — and whether you can beat my record.

dialogue.sit: Allow me to give it a try.
I'll need a moment to prepare.

dialogue.t: No problem, come back whenever you're prepared.

dialogue.t: No problem, come back whenever you're prepared.
Come on, give it a try! Run through this training ground as fast as you can, but be sure <color=#00E1FFFF>not to break any of the jars</color>!
Let's see how well you do — and whether you can beat my record.
You did pretty well, but honestly... Not to brag, my best record is still better than yours.
I mean, everyone's got one or two things they're really good at.
See? Even someone with my build can be agile. So, make sure to eat properly and don't go on any crazy diets!
Illimani, you seem to have gained some weight again — congrats!
Haha, thanks, Suriqui.
Good news, by the by — I just talked another skinny person out of dieting the other day.
Oh, nice! That's awesome!
Hey, what about you? Been eating well these days?
That's what I like to hear — eat more, get nice and chubby.
Oh, by the way, Illimani, this person's jar-smashing record is insane — just a little short of my best.
He(She) even challenged me here. Did pretty well, too.
Wow, not bad! Didn't expect you to be so good — almost beat the two of us.
Honestly, if he(she) gains a bit more weight, he(she) might actually beat us.
Yeah, totally possible. But honestly, you're still a bit too skinny — you've got room to bulk up. That said...
I approve of you!
I approve of you too!
But seriously, you should eat more at every meal.
No skipping meals, no dieting — we'd be so disappointed if you did.

quests.description: Praise the almighty fat! A fearsome warrior must pack as powerful a paunch as they do a punch!
